notes: Court ROI for outputs/test-video2/work.mp4 (1920x884), derived from a permissive calibration pass rather than by eye: the near player's foot cloud spans x 0.20-0.86 y 0.67-1.00, the far player's x 0.20-0.40 y 0.55-0.68, and the courtside crowd sits at x 0.74-0.90 y 0.63-0.72 with the left-hand spectators pinned at x 0.11.
